subject: Re: CAIQ package and control-to-evidence commitments for AlcyonBank
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@alcyonbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ worksheet and scoping question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking this on. Attached is our completed CAIQ spreadsheet (v4) with a few clarifying notes in the 'customer_comments' column. We need Redwood to: 1) confirm scope (which services are in-scope for our SaaS tenant), 2) map each filled CAIQ question to the Redwood artifact(s) and control owner, and 3) provide a plan to deliver supporting artifacts/log samples for the items marked as "evidence required".

High level constraints:
- We need the initial mapping back by EOD Thu 8/12 to feed into our compliance window.
- Anything that requires infra access (runtime logs, KV cache samples) will need a secure transfer process (SFTP or DocuSign-style upload portal).

Can you confirm scope and a short timeline? Also please call out any items likely to need remediation or compensating controls.

Attachment: Alcyon_CAIQ_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

Best,
Amelia
Amelia Torres
Senior Security Analyst | AlcyonBank
amelia@alcyonbank.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amelia Torres <amelia@alcyonbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ worksheet and scoping question

Thanks Amelia — looping in Kim and Marissa to own the mapping and artifact collection.

Quick answers up front:
- Scope: Hosted Redwood API (text generation + embeddings) for AlcyonBank tenant "alcyon-prod". Private features (VPC private deploy) are out of scope for this questionnaire unless you flag them in the spreadsheet.
- Timeline: on our side we can produce a draft control->artifact mapping by Thu 8/12 and a deliverable bundle (logs + annotated artifacts) by Tue 8/17, assuming we can stage requested runtime samples.

Kim/Marissa — proposed approach:
1) Triage the CAIQ sheet: mark each question as (a) declarative (we can assert), (b) needs artifact, or (c) needs remediation/compensating control. Use the column "redwood_action" in the attached stub.
2) For items that need artifacts: list the artifact file name, owner, and an estimated prep time (hours). Common artifacts will be: config screenshots, design narrative (pdf), keystore rotation logs, KV-cache prefix logs, prefix cache sample (gzip), and API access control snapshots.
3) Create a mapping CSV (caiq-stub-index.csv) and a small artifact bundle (redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.zip) with redactions as needed.

Risks/asks:
- We will need redwood-infra team help for KV/cache runtime trace samples (these contain ephemeral keys). Kim, can you confirm who to tag in infra?
- If Alcyon requires full raw logs, we should propose sampled slices only (30-min windows) and an SFTP upload link.

I'll reply to Amelia with draft deliverable dates after we have the stub CSV.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ worksheet and scoping question — proposed owner map

Sofia / Marissa — I reviewed Amelia's CAIQ and prepared an initial owner map and artifact plan. Key notes below; CSV attached.

Summary of high-impact items:
- CCM-CP-01 / CAIQ-DEV-12 (key rotation): owner = Priya Natarajan (IAM). Artifact = key-rotation-report-2026-Q2.pdf (we can redact key IDs). Prep time: 2 hours.
- CCM-TR-03 / CAIQ-OPS-07 (runtime telemetry): owner = Diego Fernandez (Runtime). Artifact = kv-cache-prefix-sample-20260805.tar.gz (sampled, sanitized). Prep time: 6 hours + infra coordination.
- CCM-DI-02 / CAIQ-APP-03 (data-in-motion): owner = Jordan Blake (Networking). Artifact = tls-config-snapshot.pdf. Prep time: 1 hour.

Attachments: caiq-stub-index.csv (columns: caid, question, recommended_artifact, owner, prep_hours, notes)

Infra ask: Diego will need ticket to pull KV prefix logs. Diego's team requires a signed PDP (data processing) ack from Alcyon for tenant-scoped logs. Amelia — can you confirm that Alcyon can sign a PDP or provide a secure transfer method? If not, we'll provide aggregated telemetry instead.

Proposed deliverables:
- 8/12 EOD: caiq-stub-index.csv (draft mapping)
- 8/14: artifact bundle v1 (redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.zip) with low-sensitivity artifacts and narratives
- 8/17: sampled telemetry + final annotated mapping (if PDP signed)

I'll attach the CSV now. If no objections, I'll start the infra ticket and flag Priya, Diego, Jordan.

Attachment: caiq-stub-index.csv

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Principal Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@alcyonbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ package and control-to-evidence commitments for AlcyonBank

Amelia — thanks for the worksheet. We validated scope for the "alcyon-prod" tenant and created a short runbook for evidence delivery. High-level plan below and a couple of clarifying asks.

Plan / delivery cadence:
- Draft control->artifact mapping (CSV) — delivered Thu 2026-08-12 EOD. (Attached: caiq-stub-index.csv)
- Artifact bundle v1 (design narratives, config snapshots, and low-sensitivity proofs) — delivered Sat 2026-08-14.
- Telemetry/log sample delivery — target Tue 2026-08-17, contingent on receipt of your PDP signature or confirmation of secure transfer method.

Clarifying asks for AlcyonBank security ops:
1) PDP: please confirm whether you can sign our standard PDP for tenant-scoped runtime log extracts. If you prefer a secure upload portal instead, we can send a DocuSign/transfer link.
2) Sampling window: specify a 30-min window (UTC) for runtime sample or confirm we can choose a representative window (we recommend Tue 2026-08-10 15:00-15:30 UTC).

Links:
- CAIQ mapping runway (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/CAIQ+Mapping+Runway
- Secure transfer (DocuSign placeholder): https://docusign.net/tx/ABC123456789

Attachments included in first bundle: redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.zip (contains annotated mapping, narrative PDFs, and redacted config screenshots). We will mark anything with tenant-identifying values for redaction.

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and I will confirm when the stub CSV is uploaded to your portal.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
